text: I think traditions connect us with our history and give us a sense of identity. For example, in Kazakhstan, we celebrate Nauryz every spring, and the whole family gets together. If young people stop doing these things, they might forget where they come from. Also, traditions are fun, and they bring people closer. So I believe we should keep them, even if life is changing.

tips.en: A national festival makes the answer personal and specific.
tips.kk: Ұлттық мереке жауапты жеке әрі нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Национальный праздник делает ответ личным и конкретным.
tips.example: For example, in Kazakhstan, we celebrate Nauryz every spring

tips.en: A conditional with 'might' shows a possible consequence.
tips.kk: «might» бар шартты сөйлем ықтимал салдарды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Условное предложение с «might» показывает возможное последствие.
tips.example: If young people stop doing these things, they might forget where they come from

note.en: knowing who you are and where you belong

questions.followUp: Which traditions matter most in your country?
questions.question: Why is it important to keep traditions alive?

text: To some extent, yes. Many teenagers prefer global trends, like pop music and fast fashion, because they see them on social media every day. But I wouldn't say they've lost interest completely. Some young people are actually proud of their roots and wear traditional clothes at festivals. I think it just depends on whether families and schools encourage them to learn about their heritage.

tips.en: 'To some extent' gives partial agreement instead of a flat yes.
tips.kk: «To some extent» нақты «иә» орнына ішінара келісімді білдіреді.
tips.ru: «To some extent» даёт частичное согласие вместо категоричного «да».

tips.en: The qualification shows you are not over-generalising.
tips.ru: Оговорка показывает, что вы не обобщаете.
tips.example: But I wouldn't say they've lost interest completely

questions.question: Do you think young people are less interested in traditional culture today?

text: It can be both good and bad. On the positive side, tourists bring money, so local people can afford to protect old buildings and festivals. But sometimes culture becomes a show just for visitors, and the real meaning gets lost. For instance, in some places people wear traditional costumes only to take photos. I think the best way is to welcome tourists but also protect local customs.

tips.en: The 'positive side / But' pair organises pros and cons.
tips.kk: «positive side / But» жұбы артықшылық пен кемшілікті ретке келтіреді.
tips.ru: Пара «positive side / But» упорядочивает плюсы и минусы.
tips.example: On the positive side, tourists bring money

tips.en: A vivid example shows how culture loses its meaning.
tips.kk: Көрнекі мысал мәдениеттің мәнін қалай жоғалтатынын көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Наглядный пример показывает, как именно культура теряет смысл.
tips.example: For instance, in some places people wear traditional costumes only to take photos

questions.followUp: Can it also be a positive thing?
questions.question: How does tourism affect local culture?

text: I think they'll become more similar in some ways, because of the internet and global brands. People in different countries already watch the same films and eat at the same restaurants. But I don't think local cultures will disappear completely. People usually want to keep something special that belongs only to them, like their language or food. So the world will probably be a mix of both.

tips.en: Specific reasons for the prediction are named.
tips.example: because of the internet and global brands

tips.en: Arguing against your own point makes the position balanced.
tips.kk: Өз пікіріне қарсы айту ұстанымды салмақты етеді.
tips.ru: Возражение самому себе делает позицию взвешенной.
tips.example: But I don't think local cultures will disappear completely
